task_completion.description: The DICOM image (0002.DCM) is successfully loaded into the viewer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The viewer displays an X-ray Angiography (XA) image showing cardiac/vessel structures.

task_completion.description: The distance measurement tool is selected and active.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The measurement icon is highlighted in the toolbar or the cursor has changed to a crosshair/ruler icon.

task_completion.description: A measurement line is drawn across the central prominent structure (Aortic Root).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A line with endpoints and a distance value is visible over the central vessel structure.

task_completion.description: The measurement line is labeled exactly 'Aortic Root'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text label reading 'Aortic Root' is visible next to the measurement line or within a properties dialog box.

task_completion.description: The agent initiates the export process to save the view as a PNG.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An 'Export' or 'Save As' dialog window is visible with the file format set to PNG.

task_completion.description: The file is saved to the specified path '~/DICOM/exports/labeled_vessel.png'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The file path '/home/ga/DICOM/exports/labeled_vessel.png' is typed into the save dialog or a confirmation message appears.

integrity.description: The agent used the GUI to perform the measurement and labeling rather than terminal scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on UI buttons, and manual typing in dialog boxes rather than just a terminal window.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply copy a pre-existing image to the destination path.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen interacting with the DICOM viewer's export menu rather than using a 'cp' command in the terminal.

integrity.description: The measurement line was manually placed on the vessel.
integrity.visual_evidence: The line endpoints are aligned with the anatomical boundaries of the vessel in the viewer.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must use the DICOM viewer to open 0002.DCM. It must draw a distance line on the central vessel and label it exactly 'Aortic Root'. The final output must be a PNG file saved to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/labeled_vessel.png with a file size of at least 5000 bytes.
